question: Which of the following acts was aimed at establishing a federal polity in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Government of India Act, 1935**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India Act, 1935** was a landmark legislation aimed at introducing a system of **federal governance** in India.
 
• This Act proposed the establishment of an **All-India Federation**, comprising provinces and princely states as units.
 
• It provided for a division of powers between the **federal government** and the provincial governments
